---
title: "Notebook Guide"
---

The notebooks are designed as a teaching pipeline. They are intentionally lean and annotated so readers can see what each step contributes.

## 01 Clean Donated Watch Data

[Open notebook 01](scripts/01_clean_donated_watch_data.html)

Reads mock Takeout watch-history JSON files, identifies valid YouTube watch rows, handles ads and details fields, extracts `video_id`, cleans multilingual title prefixes, and writes cleaned watch tables.

## 02 Clean Donated Search Data

[Open notebook 02](scripts/02_clean_donated_search_data.html)

Reads mock Takeout search-history JSON files, identifies genuine search-query rows with multilingual action-prefix logic, decodes search queries from URLs, and writes search-history tables.

## 03 Scrape YouTube Metadata

[Open notebook 03](scripts/03_scrape_youtube_metadata.html)

Shows how to collect video-level metadata with `yt_dlp`. This notebook is documented but not executed in the public site because a real run requires authorization and a registered identifying User-Agent token.

## 04 Link Watch Data, Metadata, And Exposure Context

[Open notebook 04](scripts/04_link_watch_metadata.html)

Joins cleaned watch events to video metadata and adds event-level search-associated, subscribed-channel, Shorts/Longs, day/night, and problematic-view labels.

## 05 Demonstrate Enriched Exposure Measures

[Open notebook 05](scripts/05_demonstrate_enriched_exposure_measures.html)

The showcase notebook. It displays selected enriched watch events and creates figures demonstrating pathway mix, participant-level indicator shares, day/night by format, and problematic/unavailable-view signals.
